title: Dallas & Fort Worth Combo City Sightseeing Tour Small-Group
includes: Small-group combination tour of Dallas and Fort Worth highlights
The listed price does not include a parking fee, payable at the time of tour check-in

policies: IMPORTANT: YOU MUST CALL OUR OFFICE THE NIGHT BEFORE YOUR TOUR TO CONFIRM YOUR DEPARTURE TIME. THIS TOUR MAY DEPART AT EITHER 8:50 AM OR 10:00 AM, DEPENDING ON THE SCHEDULE. FAILURE TO CONFIRM YOUR DEPARTURE TIME MAY RESULT IN MISSING YOUR TOUR.
